reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish, and nothing here tells me the things my electrician needs: UL listing, lumens, dimming, canopy and install details. I just walked out of a showroom without buying, so I'm not handing $360 to an unknown store on a 10 to 12 day wait.
objection: No UL listing or full specs shown, an unknown brand, and I'd pay return shipping on a big, awkward pendant if it doesn't look right in my room. 10 to 12 business days is a long wait for a light.
would_change_my_mind: A full spec sheet with UL/ETL listing, lumens and dimmer compatibility, plus free returns or a sample, and real customer photos or reviews from installed pieces.
